scope: Unprivileged host, private file-backed QEMU. RAM root and LVM/ext4 data workload; not complete Ubuntu root-disk recovery. Online prefix validation is not cold-crash durability.
measurement_limits: Single small sample per case, 3 correct replug cycles or 1 wrong disk cycle; not broad fault coverage.
CPU from 10-second daemon utime+stime ticks, excludes child processes and cannot measure spikes.
Parallel host VM work and differing snapshots/builds prevent claiming a version speedup.
Explicit scsi_id and Ubuntu DM udev rules retained; not full 0.15.0 package integration.

cases.scope: RAM root, version-selected multipathd, whole USB disk -> kpartx -> LVM -> ext4 data workload; not Ubuntu root recovery
cases.effective_defaults:
defaults {
	verbosity 3
	polling_interval 1
	max_polling_interval 4
	reassign_maps "no"
	path_selector "round-robin 0"
	path_grouping_policy "failover"
	uid_attribute "ID_SERIAL"
	prio "const"
	prio_args ""
	features "0"
	path_checker "tur"
	alias_prefix "mpath"
	failback "manual"
	max_fds "max"
	no_path_retry 8
	queue_without_daemon "no"
	allow_usb_devices "yes"
	flush_on_last_del "never"
	user_friendly_names "no"
	fast_io_fail_tmo 5
	log_checker_err "always"
	all_tg_pt "no"
	retain_attached_hw_handler "yes"
	detect_prio "no"
	detect_checker "yes"
	detect_pgpolicy "yes"
	detect_pgpolicy_use_tpg "no"
	force_sync "no"
	strict_timing "no"
	deferred_remove "no"
	delay_watch_checks "no"
	delay_wait_checks "no"
	san_path_err_threshold "no"
	san_path_err_forget_rate "no"
	san_path_err_recovery_time "no"
	marginal_path_err_sample_time "no"
	marginal_path_err_rate_threshold "no"
	marginal_path_err_recheck_gap_time "no"
	marginal_path_double_failed_time "no"
	find_multipaths "strict"

	retrigger_tries 3
	retrigger_delay 10

	skip_kpartx "no"
	purge_disconnected "no"
	remove_retries 0
	ghost_delay "no"

	enable_foreign "NONE"
	marginal_pathgroups "off"
	recheck_wwid "yes"
}
